faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Fairfax?
faq.answer: Fairfax homeowners typically invest $6,000 to $14,000 for a full window replacement project. This eco-conscious Marin County town features older Craftsman and Victorian homes along Sir Francis Drake, as well as hillside properties with custom windows framing views of Mt. Tamalpais. Single window installation starts at approximately $575.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Fairfax?
faq.answer: Yes. Fairfax requires a building permit for window replacements. Given the town's sustainability-focused character, energy-efficient windows with strong green building credentials are often preferred. Our team manages all Town of Fairfax permit applications on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Fairfax?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Fairfax commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Fairfax?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Fairfax replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Fairfax?
faq.answer: Most Fairfax projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
